elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.biomass_briquet: Dried algae, pressed. Burns as long as coal and grows back.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.plant_fibre: Leaves and stems, pressed and combed. The loom takes it from here.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.verdigris: Copper that has been given time and damp. The green in this set.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.woven_cane: Bamboo split and woven flat. Light, and it grows back.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.solar_brass_ing: Copper warmed with a little gold. Every machine here is built of it.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.bloom_resin: Lichen set in wax. Holds a light without burning anything.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.rammed_earth: Soil, gravel and clay driven together. Cheap, and it never runs out.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.pale_plaster: A lime wall that throws daylight back into the room.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.verdigris_coppe: Copper panel, aged green on purpose and then stopped there.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.solar_brass_blo: Nine ingots, kept where you can find them.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.woven_cane_bloc: A wall you could carry one-handed.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.mosaic_tile: Fired clay and glaze, set by hand. No two faces match.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.cane_lattice: Screening. Keeps the sun off without keeping the air out.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.copper_grating: Walkway and vent cover. Machinery looks like it is running under it.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.power_governor: One rule for the grid it is attached to: when something is true, stop a class of machine and everything below it. Use it to cycle the condition, sneak-use to cycle what is held. It says the whole rule back either way.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.power_conduit: Carries power from a generator to everything on the run. Use it empty-handed to read the grid: what is attached, in which priority class, and what is browned out.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.greenhouse_fram: Glazing in a brass frame. Light in, weather out.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.bloom_glass: Lit from inside, and never warm to the touch.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.bloom_lantern: The brightest thing here, and it burns nothing to do it.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.living_wall: Planting held against a cane screen. Grows over anything.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.terrace_planter: A bed of soil in a cane box. Put it anywhere flat.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.white_marble: Cool white, cut with grey. The one with a line in it.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.white_marble_co: Copper worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Copper inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.white_marble_go: Gold worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Gold inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.white_marble_ir: Iron worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Iron inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.white_marble_br: Solar Brass worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Solar Brass inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.white_limestone: Warm white, full of the small shells it was made from.
Copper worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Copper inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
Gold worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Gold inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
Iron worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Iron inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
Solar Brass worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Solar Brass inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.alabaster: White, and almost nothing else. Somewhere for the eye to rest.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.alabaster_coppe: Copper worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Copper inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.alabaster_gold_: Gold worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Gold inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.alabaster_iron_: Iron worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Iron inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.alabaster_brass: Solar Brass worked into a border. Panelling, once you put four together.
Solar Brass inlaid as an ornament, four scrolls around a boss.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.solar_condenser: Gathers power from direct skylight, and less of it under cover.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.algae_bioreacto: Grows biomass fuel from water and skylight. Needs power, and water touching it.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.wind_capstan: Gathers power from open sky, and more of it with height. Wants open sides, not a clear roof.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.water_reclaimer: Condenses clean water out of air and rain, and stores it. Needs power. Counts as a bioreactor's water.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.ceramic_kiln: Fires clay and glass on less fuel than a furnace needs. Burns fuel or runs on power.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.mycelium_press: Presses plant matter and mycelium into panels and fibre. Needs power.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.fibre_loom: Weaves cane and fibre into cloth, cord and panels. Needs power.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.aquaponics_tank: Grows crops and fish together off one supply of water. Needs power, water touching it, and light.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.harvester: Cuts and replants the field around it, and posts the crop into whatever is underneath. Needs power.
elysiumsolarpunk.tooltip.tree_harvester: Fells grown trees around it, replants a sapling, and posts the timber into whatever is underneath. Needs power.
elysiumsolarpunk.power.class.critical.bl: Water, air and food. The last thing to lose power.
elysiumsolarpunk.power.class.defense.blu: Whatever answers a siege. Nothing is built for this yet.
elysiumsolarpunk.power.class.logistics.b: Moving things: harvesters and everything that carries.
elysiumsolarpunk.power.class.industry.bl: Turning things into other things. Most machines are this.
elysiumsolarpunk.power.class.comfort.blu: Light, warmth and ornament. The first thing to lose power.
elysiumsolarpunk.power.readout.empty: Nothing attached. Run the conduit to a machine.
elysiumsolarpunk.power.condition.charge_: the grid is under a quarter charged
the grid is under half charged
the grid is over three quarters charged
elysiumsolarpunk.power.governor.rule: Rule: while %s, hold %s and everything below it.
elysiumsolarpunk.power.governor.hint: Use to change when; sneak-use to change what.
